Title: Introducing promotional pricing for data transfer to Azure Front Door

Body.Content:
Promotional pricing for data transfer to Azure Front Door is now available. From now to November 30, 2019, all data transfer between Azure Services and Azure Front Door will be free of charge. Total savings will depend on which datacenters your Azure Front Door backends are hosted. Normal data transfer billing will resume on December 1, 2019, and will be reflected in your January 2020 invoice.

Learn more
